_comment: A book somebody wrote, and the only place the grammar is taught: `and`, `only`, `except` and the
rungs are structure, so no page loot hands them out and no device derives one. A writer meets them
here and learns them by reading (design 4.5).
Rarer than a linking book on purpose. A linking book is a way home and you want one early; this is a
lesson, and finding a second before you have understood the first is worth much less than finding
one at a time. What it says comes from `art/generation/book.json`, so retuning is a datapack edit.
